title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: All-1 fragment payload extracted from unshifted wire data
description:
In `Fragment::from_bytes` (fragment.rs:256), the All-1 case returns `payload: &data[2 + MIC_LENGTH..data.len() - 1]` which slices the raw wire bytes. The wire bytes were left-shifted by 1 bit during encoding, but `from_bytes` correctly shifts them back into the `body` buffer. The MIC extraction uses `body[2..2+MIC_LENGTH]` (correctly shifted), but the payload extraction skips the shift and pulls raw bytes from `data`.

This produces incorrect payload content for All-1 fragments. The payload should be extracted from `body[2+MIC_LENGTH..2+content_len]` (like the non-All-1 case), not from `data`.

Additionally, the range `data.len() - 1` omits the last byte which contains partial payload data (only the padding bit should be excluded, not the entire last byte).
